x: Thus at the end of 3 miles the first to appear was Holden, of Tipton; Howard, of Kettering; Beman, Birchfield; and Evenson, of Salford. Our Bert was here definitely 62nd, Warboys 85th, Allum 97th, Bill Webb 101st, Ernie Duffett 128th, Frank Webb 137th and Bill Rice 182nd.
Long Jump Match.—(1) Moss (T), 19ft.; (2) Jones (B), 18ft. 8½; (3) Moreton (T), 18ft. 2¼. 220 Yards Match.—(1) Ransome (T); (2) Botwright (B); (3) Howard (T); (4) Bowers (B). 24.4.

After 2½ miles Howard(Watford) led the field from Lindsell (Portsmouth) and Baker(Walton). Ken Miller was now 29th, John Thresher 50th, Derek Crookes 92nd and Jim Radford 107th; Trevor Hart being forced to drop back a considerable way with trouble from a shoulder ailment.
